preservedDesign: Original full-screen banner/scrim and plain vector BackAction
Fraunces/Segoe UI, warm ink, Colosseum gold and glass/borders
Letter tile; separate provider heading, gold quality and bounded release
Seeder count, size and source origin remain separate metadata; missing/negative seeder values never printed
Audio, languages, format tags and stream-kind/label all retained
Round gold Play/down-arrow, round Copy and independent Download/queued controls
Whole-row source activation; original extension dropdown with counts and quick quality pills
Internal glass-table scrolling and original keyboard/right-click context options
Download and full-season mode using original selection semantics, locally simulated
fittingChanges: Portrait preserves 200px hero, 16px margins and stacked responsive inline original source row
Landscape compresses hero to 96px or 82px when height<385px, repositions existing title next to Back
Landscape row circular actions move into a 174px right-side column so all stay visible without wrapping
Glass header switches between 70px two-line phone portrait and 44px one-line landscape; all rows scroll
Phone detection uses min(width,height)<600 so landscape phones remain phones and 800px tablets stay tablets
Outside-frame editable logical width/height, four safe insets, two font scales and Play/Download/Season state
unresolved: OnePlus exact logical viewport/DPR and safe insets remain unmeasured; prescribed values are provisional
Franchise/scene local art is a declared fallback, not a verified per-title runtime backdrop
Source rows and provider data are illustrative; no stream/provider availability is claimed
Browser backdrop-filter approximates rather than proves Qt MultiEffect/Glass pixel matching
No APK, QML integration, native pointer/IME, real provider, clipboard, playback, download or on-device verification
Closed Theatre parent is a minimal contextual preview rather than a full independent detail-page study
